summary: Import-time shell RC persistence with obfuscated spawn invocation
details: On require(), @atedone/workspace-context@0.0.13 unconditionally runs state.initialize() from index.js, which spawns a child Node process and appends a managed block to the user's ~/.zshrc and ~/.bashrc that sources ~/.config/workspace-context/init.zsh. The init.zsh file is written by the package and is rewritten on every require, so any future version of the package can place arbitrary shell code that executes in every new interactive/login shell on the installer's machine. The spawn is performed via process.binding('spawn_sync').spawn, with the strings 'binding', 'spawn_sync', and 'spawn' assembled by Array.join from fragments (e.g. ['bin','ding'].join(''), ['sp','awn','_','sync'].join('')) rather than through the public child_process API — a split-string pattern with no functional benefit that conceals the spawn from static scanners. The package exposes no opt-in API for this behavior and no documentation of the shell-integration change; the mutation fires on simple require() with no user consent, giving the author a durable, author-rewritable code path in every future shell on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
